title: Taras learns karate
scene: Taras starts karate at a dojo near his school. His sensei has a black belt and a fifth dan and also teaches kung fu; the kids do sparring every Friday, watch sumo on TV and meet a young gymnast from the next hall.

words.ex: My son takes karate lessons after school.
I train at a dojo near my house.
Our sensei teaches karate on Mondays.
He has a second dan in karate now.
He has studied kung fu since he was six.
Boxers do sparring three times a week.
We watched sumo on TV in Japan.
The young gymnast landed her jump perfectly.
She asked her senpai for advice.

old_story: Taras is Anna's little brother, and he starts [[karate]] this month. His [[dojo]] is near his school. His [[sensei]] has a black belt and a fifth [[dan]]. She also teaches [[kung fu]] on weekends. Every Friday, the kids do [[sparring]] in pairs. At home, Taras watches [[sumo]] on TV with Dad. One day, he meets a young [[gymnast]] from the next hall. She can do a perfect split, and Taras wants to try. Now he practices kicks and splits every day.

title: Boxing night
scene: Max and his friends watch a night of boxing and MMA. The young challenger is the underdog in this fight, but the fighter makes a comeback against the champ and wins by knockout; the commentator screams, the fans are in euphoria, and later they watch the highlights.

words.ex: The young boxer trains at the gym every morning.
He trains MMA three times a week.
The young challenger beat the champion.
Everyone was cheering for the underdog.
Is the fight on TV today?
I want to be a fighter, so I train every day.
The team made a great comeback in the second half.
He is the new world boxing champ.
He won the fight by knockout.
The commentator got excited after the goal.
The fans were in euphoria after the big win.
Watch the highlights of last night's game.
Who is the world champion now?

old_story: On Saturday night, Max invites his friends over to watch sports on TV. First they see a famous [[boxer]] win easily, and then the [[MMA]] event begins. The young [[challenger]] is clearly the [[underdog]], and nobody expects him to win. The main [[fight]] starts badly for him, and he falls in the first round. But this [[fighter]] does not give up, and slowly he makes a [[comeback]]. In the third round, he hits the [[champ]] hard and wins by [[knockout]]. The [[commentator]] screams so loudly that Max's cat runs under the sofa. The fans in the hall are in total [[euphoria]], and so are Max's friends. Later, they watch the [[highlights|highlight]] again and again until midnight. Max says, "Tomorrow I'm going to the gym!"

title: A day at the sea
scene: On holiday by the sea Max and Anna try surfing and SUP; a surfer shows them his fiberglass surfboard, and they rent a kayak. They go diving with a diver, see a small boat's keel hit a buoy, swim in the ocean and watch people skydiving with parachutes.

words.ex: We went surfing early in the morning.
We rented a SUP and paddled around the lake.
The surfer caught a big wave.
The boat is made of fiberglass.
He carried his surfboard down to the beach.
We rented a kayak and paddled down the river.
We went diving near the coral reef.
The diver swam down to the old ship.
The boat's keel hit the rocks.
A red buoy marks the safe part of the channel.
We swam in the ocean every day.
We went skydiving for my birthday last year.
We paddled the canoe across the lake.

old_story: Max and Anna spend their summer vacation by the [[ocean]]. On the first day, they try [[surfing]] and [[SUP]]. A friendly [[surfer]] shows them his light [[fiberglass]] [[surfboard]]. Then they rent a [[kayak]] for two hours. The next morning, they go [[diving]] with a [[diver]] named Oleh. From the water, they see a small boat near the shore. Its [[keel]] hits a [[buoy]], but nobody is hurt. Above the beach, people are [[skydiving]] with colorful parachutes. In the evening, Max and Anna play [[volleyball]] on the sand. Anna wins, and Max says she is just lucky. Tired and happy, they eat ice cream and watch the sunset.

title: Golf, tennis and cricket
scene: Max's rich uncle invites him to his golf club. A caddie carries the bags, and the uncle talks about golf, tennis and the grand slam, polo, rugby and cricket, where a bowler throws the ball.

words.ex: He joined a golf club near his office.
Do you play golf?
The caddie handed him a towel.
We play tennis every Saturday morning.
She won her first grand slam at nineteen.
They watched a polo match on Sunday afternoon.
He plays rugby at his college.
Do you want to watch a cricket match?
The bowler ran in fast and hit the wickets.
We often play badminton in the backyard in summer.
We played ping-pong in the basement.
We play volleyball on the beach every summer.

old_story: Max's rich uncle Victor invites him to his [[golf club]] on Sunday. Max has never played [[golf]], so he feels a little nervous. A friendly [[caddie]] carries their heavy bags across the green grass. While they walk, Uncle Victor talks about [[tennis]] and his trip to a [[grand slam]] final. He also loves [[polo]], [[rugby]] and especially [[cricket]]. He explains that in that game a [[bowler]] throws the ball at the wickets. Max tries his first shot, but the ball flies straight into the lake. Everyone laughs, including Max himself. On the way home, Max says, "Next time, let's just play [[badminton]] in the yard."

title: Max's band
scene: Max plays bass in a rock band with friends. They practice heavy metal in a garage: the drummer keeps the rhythm, the guitarist tunes his instrument, the frontman finds the right tone, and they record a demo.

words.ex: He plays bass in a rock band.
What is your favorite band?
The drummer counted to four and started the song.
This song has a great rhythm for dancing.
The guitarist played a long solo.
Do you play a musical instrument?
The frontman sang and danced on stage.
Please don't speak to me in that tone.
The band recorded a demo in their garage.
The vocalist has a powerful voice.

old_story: Max loves [[rock]], and he plays [[bass]] in a [[band]] with friends. This month, they want to try [[heavy metal]]. Every evening, they practice in Max's garage. The [[drummer]], Ihor, keeps a fast [[rhythm]]. The [[guitarist]], Sofia, tunes her [[instrument]] very carefully. Their [[frontman]], Dima, cannot find the right [[tone]] for a new song. He tries again and again, and finally it sounds great. On Sunday, they record their first [[demo]] on a phone. Max sends it to Anna, and she says it's loud but cool.
